# Investing Launch

Map of content for ETF investing on DriveWealth. Priority #1 since the Q3 plan.

## Status (Oct 9)

- Beta live since Sep 8 to 5% of MTU (~5k users).
- Go/no-go #1 on Sep 29: **NO-GO.** Three blockers: reconciliation fix (Devon), disclosures final review (Hana), Android parity (2 screens).
- Since then: disclosures signed Oct 7. Recon fix in review, due Oct 14. Android parity due Oct 15.
- Go/no-go #2 on Oct 16. GA target Oct 20, **at risk.**
- Pillar's condition (Aug 28, Priya Shah): $2,500/user daily funding cap for the first 90 days. Stays.
- Growth experiments frozen during beta. Kavi needs an unfreeze date.

Risk: positions that don't reconcile to DriveWealth block GA outright; everything else is negotiable.
